ask: Put a Threads post up for today's flash sale: code FLASH20 for 20% off, ends at midnight.

steps.why: Limits once: 500 characters, and longer becomes a reply chain, which a ghost post can't be.

arguments.content: Flash sale, today only: FLASH20 takes 20% off everything until midnight.

steps.why: The decision: a ghost post, because the offer is dead after midnight and a lasting post would keep advertising an expired code. So it stays one short text part with no image and no poll (either would make it a normal, lasting post, without an error). The topic puts it where shoppers browse; in platform_specific the tag alone is enough, no use_topic_tag. Both settings ride the saving call.
Ghost and topic are read back from metadata.platformSpecific.threads; unknown keys are kept quietly, so check the spelling landed before saying it is set.

say: Saved to Acme as a Threads draft: "Flash sale, today only: FLASH20 takes 20% off everything until midnight." Topic: Small Business. It disappears 24 hours after it goes out, so schedule it for this morning. Nothing goes out yet. What time?
never: Adding the product photo or a poll: the post would no longer disappear.
A ghost post for anything people should find later.
Typing #SmallBusiness into the text instead of the topic setting.
